title.narrative: Stronger democratic institutions in Eastern Partnership countries: an ODIHR project supported and funded by the EU

description.narrative:
Overall objective: Democratic institutions in EaP partner countries are more inclusive, accountable, transparent, human rights and rule of law compliant.

Specific objective 1: Democratic institutions are better able to engage in evidence-based reforms with greater accountability, integrity and inclusivity.

Specific objective 2: Political parties are governed by rule of law and human rights compliant and gender sensitive regulations.

Specific objective 3: Administrative justice bodies responsible for adjudication of elections and fundamental civil and political rights operate more effectively and in accordance with international standards.

Specific objective 4: Enhanced collaboration on addressing key recommendations to improve electoral processes in EaP partner countries.
